notes.title: Locomotion Update Released!
notes.content:
GONZO version 1.0.2 is out now, with new locomotion settings that some players have been requesting! This update gives you more control over how you move around and play the game, and makes both seated and roomscale play more comfortable:


Adds a new “Settings” menu in the main menu
Adds a setting to change between controller-oriented (default) and head-oriented movement. In controller-oriented, your joystick movement is relative to the direction you point the controller. In head-oriented, your joystick movement is relative to the direction you’re looking.
Adds a setting to enable smooth turning. When smooth turning is off (default), rotating happens in 45 degree increments. When smooth turning is on, you smoothly rotate for as long as you hold the turn button.
Adds a crouch toggle feature: pushing down on the joystick (center of trackpad for Vive) will toggle crouching, making you shorter and harder to detect. You can still physically crouch, but this should make seated play a more comfortable option (or play standing and don't worry about doing squats!)


Thanks again to everyone that has been playing and reaching out with suggestions and bug reports. We'll be continuing to monitor our Steam Community and have also set up a Discord server which you can join here: https://discord.gg/Y58wX3kq


Please feel free to post any bug reports or suggestions to our Community page or our Discord!

notes.title: Launch Patch Released!
notes.content:
The first patch is ready and resolves a number of bugs that were reported during the first 2 weeks after launch:

 Fixed hands freezing during the weapon handling tutorial level
 Fixed lasers in missile silo not being disabled by computer
 Fixed dungeon cultists not returning to the ritual chamber after alert
 Fixed dungeon cultists not alerting properly under certain conditions
 Removed any floor-level lasers so they can be passed by non-roomscale players
 Removed the head collision sphere
 Various performance improvements and optimizations

Thank you to everyone who has been playing so far, and thank you to everyone who has reported issues with the game! We are a two-man team and care a lot about making sure GONZO is fun and stable, and your feedback is invaluable to us. We made sure to address every single issue reported so far in this patch and we are dedicated to promptly fixing anything you report in the future. If you'd like to report a bug, please make a post in our Steam Community forum.

Thanks again,
studiopirat
